162: 	// Artifact directory lifecycle
163: 	flagArtifactDir, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("artifact-dir")
164: 	keepArtifacts, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("keep-artifacts")
165: 
166: 	var artifactDir string
167: 	var artifactIsAutoGenerated bool
168: 	var artifactTracker *artifact.Tracker
169: 
170: 	// Resolution order:
171: 	// 1. --artifact-dir flag (if non-empty) → persistent
172: 	// 2. TOML artifacts.dir (if non-empty and enabled) → persistent
173: 	// 3. TOML artifacts.enabled = true with no dir → auto-generate
174: 	// 4. None → inactive
175: 	if flagArtifactDir != "" {
176: 		expanded, expandErr := resolve.Workdir("", flagArtifactDir)
177: 		if expandErr != nil {

179: 		}
180: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(expanded) {

197: 			return &ExitError{Code: 2, Err: fmt.Errorf("failed to get cache dir for artifacts: %w", cacheErr)}
198: 		}
199: 		// Generate unique run ID: timestamp + 6-char random hex
200: 		var randBytes [3]byte
201: 		if _, randErr := rand.Read(randBytes[:]); randErr != nil {
202: 			return &ExitError{Code: 1, Err: fmt.Errorf("failed to generate artifact run ID: %w", randErr)}
203: 		}
204: 		runID := time.Now().Format("20060102T150405") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(randBytes[:])
